$comment: Issue #43. Names given to a child whose parent left the name blank. Short, gentle, easy to read aloud; letters only (CHILD_NAME_PATTERN); none is an everyday English word, a franchise character or a name used in fixtures (Milo, Juno, Theo), so the quality gate's name checks cannot be fooled by the story's own words. test/unit/child-names.test.ts checks every entry against the schema and the L1 blocklist.
